data.narrative:
Cambium is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Simon Waddington and Stephan Herrera that has raised $127M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company operating in the same sector at similar stages, including peers such as Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $127M total raised proxy, yielding $241M. Peer-median analysis references three same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.8B and a range of $1.6B to $2.0B (Dexterity at the low end, Generalist AI at $2.0B). The peer set includes five additional private reference points: Divergent and Exotec among them.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $205M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $996M. The wide dispersion reflects material tension between the stage-progression method and peer-median approach. Stage-progression, anchored to capital raised, implies a more conservative valuation; peer-median suggests substantially higher value. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers, the representativeness of the three-company peer median in a fragmented robotics sector, and whether Cambium's specific capabilities command a premium or discount to observed market multiples.
